newsitem.title: USA: Ill. school referendum approval at 30 pct - group.
newsitem.headline: Ill. school referendum approval at 30 pct - group.

text.p: Illinois voters approved only 30 percent of tax and bond referendums on the Nov. 5 ballot, according to a report by the Illinois Association of School Administrators.
The group said 16 of the 55 school-related referendums on the ballot were approved, while 39 were defeated.
Voters turned down 15 proposed bond issues, while approving 13, the group reported.
On the tax levy front, voters approved only three levy increases proposed by school districts, while turning down 24.
The report was based on a telephone survey by the association.
